title: What is Pneumonia?
shortDesc: An infection that inflames the air sacs in the lungs.
desc:
Pneumonia is an infection that inflames the air sacs in one or both lungs. The air sacs may fill with fluid or pus (purulent material), causing cough with phlegm or pus, fever, chills, and difficulty breathing.

Types of Pneumonia

Pneumonia can be classified in several ways. One common classification system is based on where you acquired the infection.
author: Dr. Sarah Johnson

title: Early Symptoms of Pneumonia
desc:
Recognizing the early symptoms of pneumonia is crucial for timely treatment. Symptoms can vary depending on the type of germ causing the infection.

Common Early Symptoms

  • Cough with phlegm
  • Fever and chills
  • Shortness of breath
  • Chest pain
author: Dr. Michael Chen

title: How to Prevent Pneumonia
desc: Prevention is better than cure. Vaccines, hand hygiene, avoiding smoke, and a healthy lifestyle can significantly reduce your risk.
author: Dr. Emily Rodriguez

title: Pneumonia Treatment Options
shortDesc: From antibiotics to home care remedies.
desc: Treatment involves curing the infection and preventing complications. Some cases can be treated at home with medications, rest, and hydration.
author: Dr. James Wilson

title: Living with Pneumonia Recovery
shortDesc: Tips for a smooth recovery post-treatment.
desc: Recovery can take days to weeks. Rest, hydration, nutritious food, and following your doctor's advice are key.
author: Dr. Lisa Park

title: Pneumonia in Children
desc: Recognizing signs early and proper treatment are essential for pediatric pneumonia cases.
author: Dr. Amanda Foster
